evals.prompt: Get a streaming link for playlist P001 at 320kbps
evals.expected_output: Code that GETs /public/streaming/get-link with playlist_index='P001' and bitrate=320
assertions: The code sends a request to /api/v3/public/streaming/get-link
The request includes 'playlist_index' set to 'P001'
The request includes 'bitrate' set to 320
The request includes 'customer-id' and 'access-token' headers
The code extracts the streaming link from response data

The response ends with a credentials onboarding block that mentions MUBERT_CUSTOMER_ID and MUBERT_ACCESS_TOKEN, asks about single user vs multi-user usage, and suggests saying 'set up Mubert' or references the mubert-setup skill

evals.prompt: Set the Mubert stream intensity to low
evals.expected_output: Code that POSTs to /public/streaming/set-intensity with intensity='low'
assertions: The code sends a POST request to /api/v3/public/streaming/set-intensity
The request body includes 'intensity' set to 'low'
The request includes correct authentication headers

evals.prompt: Enable loop mode on the stream with a 30 second loop
evals.expected_output: Code that POSTs to /public/streaming/set-loop-state with loop='on' and time=30
assertions: The code sends a POST request to /api/v3/public/streaming/set-loop-state
The request body includes 'loop' set to 'on'
The request body includes 'time' set to 30
The request includes correct authentication headers

evals.prompt: Disable the loop on the Mubert stream
evals.expected_output: Code that POSTs to /public/streaming/set-loop-state with loop='off'
assertions: The code sends a POST request to /api/v3/public/streaming/set-loop-state
The request body includes 'loop' set to 'off'
The request includes correct authentication headers
The code sends a POST request to /api/v3/public/streaming/restart
The request includes 'customer-id' and 'access-token' headers

evals.prompt: Get a WebRTC streaming link for medium intensity ambient music
evals.expected_output: Code that GETs /public/streaming/get-link with type='webrtc' and intensity='medium'
assertions: The code sends a request to /api/v3/public/streaming/get-link
The request includes 'type' set to 'webrtc'
The request includes 'intensity' set to 'medium'
The request includes a 'playlist_index' parameter
The request includes correct authentication headers

evals.prompt: Write a TypeScript service that starts a Mubert stream and dynamically changes intensity based on user input
evals.expected_output: TypeScript code that gets a streaming link, then exposes methods to call set-intensity with different levels
assertions: The code is written in TypeScript
The code calls /public/streaming/get-link to obtain the stream URL
The code calls /public/streaming/set-intensity to change intensity
The code supports all three intensity levels: low, medium, high
The code includes correct authentication headers in all requests

evals.prompt: I want to stream music but I don't have credentials
evals.expected_output: The agent should recognize missing credentials and guide user to mubert-setup skill
assertions: The response mentions the need for customer-id and access-token
The response references mubert-setup skill for obtaining and configuring credentials
The response asks about single-user vs multi-user usage pattern

evals.prompt: List available playlists I can use for streaming
evals.expected_output: Code that GETs /public/playlists to show available streaming channels
assertions: The code sends a GET request to /api/v3/public/playlists
The request includes correct authentication headers
The code displays playlist_index and channel/category info
